# libxposed 102.0.0

MiAIPlus compiles against `io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0` (compile-only), and
bundles `io.github.libxposed:service:102.0.0` with its transitive runtime
`io.github.libxposed:interface:102.0.0` dependency. The API runtime is supplied
by the Xposed framework.

Upstream projects: https://github.com/libxposed/api and
https://github.com/libxposed/service (libxposed contributors).
The published Maven POMs identify the Apache License 2.0, reproduced in LICENSE.
No upstream source is vendored here.

Versioned source and license metadata used during migration:

- https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/libxposed/api/102.0.0/api-102.0.0-sources.jar
- https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/libxposed/service/102.0.0/service-102.0.0-sources.jar
- https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/libxposed/service/102.0.0/service-102.0.0.pom
- https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/libxposed/interface/102.0.0/interface-102.0.0.pom
